review_candidates.description: Introductie Voor een dynamische en groeiende organisatie binnen de Medical Devices industrie ben ik op zoek naar een ondernemende Accountmanager Gynaecologie/Verloskunde (OBGYN) voor de regio Noord-Oost Nederland. In deze uitdagende functie ben je verantwoordelijk voor het realiseren van commerciële doelstellingen, het opbouwen van duurzame relaties binnen ziekenhuizen en het succesvol introduceren van innovatieve medische hulpmiddelen binnen de gynaecologie en verloskunde. Ben jij commercieel gedreven, communicatief sterk en voel je je thuis in een omgeving waar je veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid krijgt? Dan kom ik graag met je in contact. Functieomschrijving Als Accountmanager OBGYN ben je verantwoordelijk voor het volledige accountmanagement binnen jouw regio. Je richt je op het verder uitbouwen van bestaande klantrelaties én het creëren van nieuwe kansen binnen ziekenhuizen. Daarbij overtuig je zorgprofessionals en besluitvormers van de meerwaarde van innovatieve producten voor de gynaecologie en verloskunde. Je bent actief aanwezig binnen ziekenhuizen, verzorgt productpresentaties en demonstraties en begeleidt productintroducties op de polikliniek, verloskamer en operatiekamer. Daarnaast ondersteun je zorgprofessionals tijdens procedures en bouw je langdurige relaties op met gynaecologen, verloskundigen, verpleegkundigen, OK-assistenten, inkopers en andere stakeholders. Je komt terecht in een ondernemende organisatie waar niet alles vooraf vastligt. Hierdoor krijg je veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief, ondernemerschap en de mogelijkheid om direct impact te maken op de verdere groei van de OBGYN-divisie. Verantwoordelijkheden Beheren en uitbouwen van bestaande accounts binnen jouw regio; Realiseren van commerciële doelstellingen en omzetgroei; Introduceren en positioneren van innovatieve medische hulpmiddelen; Opbouwen en onderhouden van duurzame relaties met zorgprofessionals en besluitvormers; Geven van productpresentaties, demonstraties en trainingen; Begeleiden van productintroducties, demo's en klinische trials; Ondersteunen bij adviescommissies en goedkeuringsprocedures; Actief aanwezig zijn op de poli, verloskamer en OK ter ondersteuning van producten en behandelingen; Signaleren van marktontwikkelingen en commerciële kansen; Verzorgen van aftersales en relatiebeheer; Nauw samenwerken met collega's, leveranciers en andere interne stakeholders. Functie-eisen Wij zoeken een kandidaat die energie krijgt van het bouwen aan relaties, kansen ziet waar anderen deze missen en eigenaarschap neemt over resultaten. Daarnaast beschik je bij voorkeur over: Een afgeronde hbo-opleiding in een commerciële, medische of paramedische richting; Ervaring in een commerciële buitendienstfunctie binnen Medical Devices, farmaceutische industrie of de ziekenhuiswereld; Affiniteit met of ervaring binnen gynaecologie en/of verloskunde; Een achtergrond als verloskundige, verpleegkundige, OK-assistent of productspecialist is een sterke pré; Ervaring met accountmanagement en stakeholdermanagement binnen ziekenhuizen; Commerciële drive en het vermogen om zelfstandig nieuwe kansen te creëren; Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden in het Nederlands; Goede beheersing van de Engelse taal; Een proactieve, zelfstandige en ondernemende instelling; Doorzettingsvermogen, verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel en een sterk klantgerichte houding. Bedrijfsprofiel Onze opdrachtgever is een toonaangevende speler binnen de markt voor medische hulpmiddelen en actief binnen onder andere gynaecologie, verloskunde, urologie en chirurgie. De organisatie maakt onderdeel uit van een internationale groep van distributeurs van medische technologie en bevindt zich in een sterke groeifase. De cultuur kenmerkt zich door korte lijnen, een informele werksfeer en een hoge mate van ondernemerschap. Geen strak ingerichte corporate omgeving, maar een organisatie waar vertrouwen, samenwerking en eigen initiatief centraal staan. Je komt terecht in een betrokken team waarin veel kennis aanwezig is en waar collega's elkaar ondersteunen om gezamenlijk succes te behalen. Binnen de OBGYN-divisie krijg je de unieke kans om mee te bouwen aan de verdere groei van de business en een belangrijke bijdrage te leveren aan de introductie van innovatieve producten die de patiëntenzorg verbeteren. Contact Ben jij enthousiast geworden over deze functie of wil je meer informatie ontvangen? Neem dan gerust contact op met Gabi Stolvoort via g.stolvoort@morgangreen.nl of telefonisch via 06 599 499 27 of 030 200 34 08 .

review_candidates.title: Aboriginal Family Wellbeing Worker
review_candidates.company: Hunter New England Local Health District
review_candidates.description: Where connection comes first, and every voice matters. Requisition ID: REQ698184 Employment Type: Permanent Full Time Position Classification: Aboriginal Health Worker Remuneration: $67612.00 to $97,730.00 per annum + superannuation + salary packaging Hours Per Week: 38 hours per week Location: Moree Community Health Applications Close: Wednesday 28th October 2026 This position is identified for Aboriginal people and exemption is claimed under Section 14(d) of the Anti-Discrimination Act 1977. Applicants must also be female under Section 31(2)(h) of the Anti-Discrimination Act 1977. Applicants must be female under Section 31 (2) (h) of the Anti-Discrimination Act 1977. About The Role And Where You Will Be Working Based at Moree Community Health Service, you’ll join the Hunter New England Violence, Abuse and Neglect (VAN) Service as part of a safe, supportive and highly team-oriented workplace. Working closely with the Aboriginal Health Unit, Sexual Assault Counsellors, Social Workers and other health professionals, you’ll build strong relationships with Aboriginal children, individuals, families and communities. You’ll provide culturally safe, trauma-informed support, advocacy, case coordination and community education. No two days will be the same. You may support families in crisis, develop safety plans and connect people with essential services, or work alongside local organisations at community events, delivering prevention, early intervention and health promotion. You’ll have the autonomy to work independently while being supported by an experienced, collaborative team that values cultural knowledge, respect, kindness and strong partnerships with Aboriginal communities. Where You’ll Be Working You’ll be based at Moree Community Health Service and work across the local community in partnership with Aboriginal communities, health services and community organisations. You’ll be part of a close-knit team where people support one another, share knowledge, celebrate success and genuinely care about each other’s wellbeing. About You You’re a compassionate, respectful and genuine people person who values connection, trust and walking alongside Aboriginal people, families and communities. You’ll meet people where they’re at, listen to what matters to them and support client-led goals—advocating for their needs so they don’t fall through the gaps in the system. You’ll bring a culturally safe, strengths-based and trauma-informed approach, with a willingness to learn and work within a healing framework. You’ll Be Someone Who Builds genuine relationships and enjoys getting out and connecting with community. Is comfortable having a cuppa and a yarn, listening and building trust. Works collaboratively while confidently managing your own caseload. Advocates strongly for Aboriginal people and helps connect them with the right support. Is adaptable and enjoys the variety of a role where no two days are the same. Brings warmth, integrity, respect and a genuine desire to make a difference. Experience working with Aboriginal communities or in health, community or human services is highly regarded. Most importantly, you’ll bring respect for Aboriginal culture, a willingness to learn and a genuine commitment to walking alongside people on their journey. Requirements Willingness to complete with support, the Education Centre Against Violence qualification pathway - Graduate Certificate in Human and Community Services (Interpersonal Trauma). Current drivers licence and ability to undertake travel as required What We Can Offer At Hunter New England Health, enjoy a career where you're challenged by interesting work and surrounded by spectacular locations. You'll contribute to the team enriching health in millions of ways every day. On top of this we also offer: Sustainable Healthcare: Together towards zero Monthly Allocated Days Off (for full-time employees) 4 weeks annual leave (pro-rata for part time employees) Paid parental leave (for eligible employees) - giving you the opportunity for true Worklife balance Salary packaging options - up to $11,600 plus novated leasing Fitness Passport for health and well-being - discounted gym options for you and your family Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for staff and family member The Welcome Experience The Welcome Experience helps you and your family connect with local people and resources, making it easier to settle in and feel at home in your new community. Relocating? We've Got You Covered Making a move can feel overwhelming, but support is available. The Welcome Experience is a free service designed to help health workers and their families settle into regional communities. From connecting you with local schools, childcare providers, sporting clubs, housing information, and community networks, the program helps make your transition smoother so you can feel at home sooner and start enjoying everything your new community has to offer. Learn More: www.nsw.gov.au/welcomeexperience Additional Information An eligibility list will be created for future permanent full or part time and temporary full or part time vacancies. This position is full time; however, part time/job share arrangements may also be considered. To be eligible for permanent employment in this position you must be an Australian Citizen, or a permanent resident of Australia, or a New Zealand citizen with a current New Zealand Passport. Employment of a temporary visa holder may only occur if no suitable local candidate is identified for the position; in this instance, you may only be offered employment in line with the conditions and expiry date of your visa. We are unable to accommodate visa sponsorship for applicants requiring a visa for this position. How To Apply Click apply online, submit your information and resume, and address the criteria listed below providing examples that demonstrate your ability. Are you willing to complete with support, the Education Centre Against Violence qualification pathway - Graduate Certificate in Human and Community Services (Interpersonal Trauma)? This role supports Aboriginal children and families experiencing violence, abuse and neglect. Please describe your understanding of the impacts of family and domestic violence and intergenerational trauma, and provide an example of how you have applied a culturally safe, strengths-based or trauma-informed approach in your work. Please tell us about your experience working with Aboriginal individuals, families and communities. How have you built respectful relationships, supported community engagement, and contributed to positive outcomes? Please provide a recent example. Need more information? Click here for the Position Description Find out more about applying for this position For role related queries or questions contact Jess Czepil on jessica.czepil@health.nsw.gov.au Applicants will be assessed against the essential requirements and selection criteria contained within the position description (link below). For assistance addressing selection criteria visit: https://bit.ly/3vL5fq2 Stepping Up Website is a resource designed to help indigenous job applicants apply for positions in NSW Health. For more information, please visit: http://bit.ly/HNEHealthSteppingUp. At Hunter New England Local Health District, we are an inclusive employer dedicated to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and welcoming workplace. Our commitment to a workforce that reflects the community we care for is essential for delivering the highest quality healthcare to our community. We encourage people with diverse lived experiences to apply. Please contact HNELHD-Diversity@health.nsw.gov.au for confidential support to ensure an equitable, barrier-free application process. This is a Category A position. Recommended applicants will be reviewed for compliance with NSW Health policy directive PD2023_022: Occupational Assessment, Screening and Vaccination against Specific Diseases for Category A positions prior to offer. All new employees must agree to comply with the requirements outlined in the policy. Salary Packaging: is beneficial to most HNELHD employees and may increase your take-home pay! Salary package a range of personal expenses including novated motor vehicle leases, relocation expenses, and HECS/HELP debt. Find out more by contacting SalaryPackagingPLUS! via nswhealth@salarypackagingplus.com.au or 1300 40 25 23. HNE Health employees may be eligible for a range of benefits such as allocated days off (ADO) for full time employees, long service leave, paid maternity leave, and salary packaging options including meal expenses. Connect with us on Facebook and LinkedIn ! #aboriginalemployment

review_candidates.title: Senior Engineering Manager
review_candidates.description: At Sana Commerce, we’re committed to creating an inclusive environment because we know our diverse workforce is one of our greatest strengths. It all started in 2007, with a pizza and a plan. For almost two decades Sana has helped manufacturers, distributors and wholesalers sell online, deeply integrated with their ERP. Now we are building our next product. We're building a new, AI-native product for agentic B2B commerce. It gives buyers, sellers and AI agents the same answer – the right product at the customer's contracted price – in every channel, from the web shop to email. It's built by a lean, AI-native engineering team where coding agents are part of how we ship: small teams, large scope. We're looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead engineering for our new product and to be the first leader of our fast-growing engineering community in Egypt. It's one job with two sides: Product engineering leadership. You lead the engineering organization that builds the product across our teams. You manage the engineers and make sure a lean, AI-native group of engineers across the UAE, Ukraine and Egypt delivers quickly and with high quality. Egypt site leadership. Egypt is our main engineering hub, with a rapidly expanding team. Our Egyptian engineers work in different teams, each with its own day-to-day lead. You're their local leader and first point of contact: the person who builds the community, looks after their wellbeing and growth, and helps us grow the team. Much of this is informal leadership – you lead through trust and influence, not through the reporting line. This is primarily a people and delivery leadership role rather than a hands-on coding role. You'll bring enough technical depth to understand the architecture, ask the right questions and work closely with engineers. You'll partner closely with Product Management and Architecture. What we offer The chance to shape a new AI-native product and build a new engineering site. Hybrid working, 3 days a week in our Alexandria office. A global and customized onboarding program (9,1/10 rated by previous hires); Working closely with global leaders on strategic initiatives; Job Description What you'll be doing Leading product engineering Keeping a fast-moving product on track, turning the roadmap into reliable delivery across Buyer Channels, Seller Studio and Platform. Shaping small, autonomous teams with clear ownership and ways of working that suit a distributed organization. • Helping teams get real value from AI coding agents, with clear quality standards and metrics that show measurable impact. Building in reliability with the Platform team: observability, SLOs and incident management. Coaching team leads and senior engineers, and hiring and developing engineers across all locations. Leading our Egypt engineering community Being the local face of Sana and first point of contact for every engineer in Egypt, whatever their team. Holding regular 1:1s to support engineers’ growth and careers. Building a connected Sana community in Egypt and growing the team. Qualifications What you'll bring Must-haves 5+ years in engineering management, including 2+ years leading multiple teams or team leads. A background as a senior engineer or tech lead, with a strong understanding of cloud-native, API-first systems (Azure is a plus). A track record of delivering a new product to production and running it, with measurable outcomes. Hands-on experience with AI coding tools, yourself or through teams you've led, and a clear view of where they help and where they fail. Track record of developing engineers, and excellent written and spoken English. Nice-to-haves Experience setting up or leading an engineering site. Experience with LLM or agent-based products, or with B2B commerce. Experience leading distributed teams across cultures, including through influence. Experience with Microsoft Azure cloud platform. Additional Information Who we are At Sana Commerce, our values drive everything we do: Champions of Our League – We deliver lasting success, balancing quick wins and long-term value Supercharge Our Customers – We’re revolutionizing B2B commerce together, helping our customers to lead and succeed Determined to Grow – We embrace challenges, growing and raising the bar for ourselves and our industry Bold Together – We dare to be bold because we have each other’s back Job descriptions can be tough to interpret. Even if you may not tick all the boxes, we have ambitious plans and we encourage people who share our vision and look forward to growing with us. Apply now.

review_candidates.description: Är du i början av din IT-karriär – eller kanske på väg in i din allra första roll? Då kan det här uppdraget hos SAAB i Linköping vara precis det du letar efter. Vi söker dig som är nyfiken på teknik, gillar att hjälpa andra och har ett driv att lära dig mer varje dag. Som supporttekniker hos oss får du en perfekt start i IT-branschen. Du kommer jobba nära både användare och kollegor, lösa tekniska problem och successivt bygga upp din kompetens. Du behöver inte kunna allt från början – det viktigaste är din inställning och viljan att utvecklas. Här får du chansen att växa, testa nytt och bli trygg i din roll i en miljö där du får stöd längs vägen. Vi letar just nu efter 4–5 nya kollegor som vill börja sin resa efter sommaren. Är du redo att ta första steget in i IT? Sök redan idag till oss! Som konsult på Eccera får du en trygg anställning och samlar på dig värdefull arbetslivserfarenhet på uppdrag hos våra kunder. Din konsultchef stöttar dig i din utveckling där du hela tiden fyller på med nya erfarenheter och kunskaper. En utmärkt möjlighet att göra karriär. Dina arbetsuppgifter I rollen som supporttekniker på SAAB kommer du ha varierande arbetsuppgifter. Det är en teknisk support i en primär Windowsmiljö och inom första området kommer du vara filtret, det som brukar vara den klassiska första linjen på en servicedesk. Här tar du emot samtal, löser ärenden och dokumenterar i detalj. Målet är såklart att så många ärenden som möjligt går att lösa i fronten, men ärenden som du inte lyckas lösa skickas vidare till kollegorna på Backoffice. Du kommer till stor del ta emot samtal på svenska och mer sällan på engelska, men all dokumentation kommer ske på engelska. SAAB arbetar i ärendehanteringssystemet ServiceNow. Inom området” Backoffice” jobbar du med att lösa ärenden som kommit in via telefon, chatt eller portal. De ärenden som du och dina kollegor inte löst i första kontakten går vidare till Backoffice i första steget, men även de ärenden som kommer in från Serviceportalen landar här. Här finns det möjlighet att få hjälp av de närmaste kollegorna men även kollegor i andra led, samt att söka efter information i portaler och dokumentation för att hitta en lösning på ett ärende. Inom Backoffice tar du endast emot samtal vid större driftstörningar och har därför möjlighet att jobba lite mer ostört och fördjupa dig i teknik och olika problem. Det ger därför goda möjligheter att utveckla sin kompetens som du kan dra nytta av när du nästa gång bemannar fronten. Inom området” Request fulfillment” kommer du arbeta med beställningar som bl.a. kan kräva fysisk handpåläggning. Mycket har automatiserats gällande beställningar, men vissa moment måste helt enkelt göras av en person. Din profil Du som söker denna tjänst trivs i en roll där du får ta mycket personligt ansvar och gillar variationen att arbeta i de tre olika rollerna. Du är verbal och gillar service. Med en positiv Med en positiv attityd antar du, och löser, de problem och utmaningar som du stöter på i rollen. Vidare är du mån om att ge förstklassig service och att alltid sätta kunden i fokus. Vi ser gärna att du har: Avslutad gymnasieutbildning, gärna med inriktning IT / Teknik En vilja att jobba med service på distans och hjälpa människor med tekniska problem Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska - i tal och skrift Goda kunskaper om Windows För tjänster där säkerhetsklassning krävs kan särskilda medborgarskapskrav förekomma, och svenskt medborgarskap är ett krav för denna befattning. Vad vi erbjuder På Eccera får du de verktyg du behöver för att nå dina mål. Vi erbjuder alla våra konsulter kvalificerade utbildningar och certifieringar inom den senaste tekniken. Vi sätter stort värde på att våra medarbetare hela tiden ska fortsätta att utvecklas. Därför erbjuder vi dig möjligheten att lägga upp en individuell utbildningsplan, där vi bekostar såväl studiematerial som själva certifieringarna. Under din utveckling kommer vi matcha din kompetens mot rätt uppdrag i takt med att du avancerar.

review_candidates.title: Service Engineering Specialist II - Automation
review_candidates.description: Description About WEG Electric Corp. WEG Electric Corp. is the largest industrial electric motor manufacturer in the Americas and one of the largest manufacturers of electric motors in the world producing more than 21 million units annually. Founded in 1961, WEG Electric Corp. operates mainly in the sector of capital goods, having five main businesses: Motors, Energy, Automation, Coatings Transmission & Distribution, providing global solutions for electric motors, variable frequency drives, soft starters, controls, panels, transformers, and generators. The US corporate office is located in Duluth, GA with manufacturing units in Minnesota, Indiana and Missouri with over 30 thousand employees worldwide. Visit our website to learn more: www.weg.net. About This Role WEG Electric Corp. has an exciting opportunity for a Service Engineering Specialist II to join our Automation team. This position provides technical support for WEG Automation products, including Low Voltage Drives, Soft Starters, PLCs, HMIs, and related motor control solutions. The Service Engineering Specialist II is responsible for troubleshooting technical issues, supporting customers and field service personnel, performing remote diagnostics, and providing solutions that ensure customer satisfaction and equipment performance. This role serves as a key technical resource while collaborating with customers, engineering, quality, and product management teams. Primary Responsibilities Provide technical support via phone, email, and remote connection for WEG Automation products, including LV Drives, Soft Starters, PLCs, HMIs, and basic MV/DC Drive applications. Troubleshoot electrical, control, programming, and communication issues using established diagnostic processes. Perform remote diagnostics to identify root causes and recommend corrective actions. Determine when on-site intervention is necessary and coordinate escalation to Field Service or Senior Support Engineers. Support Field Service Engineers by providing technical guidance, troubleshooting assistance, and application expertise. Document customer interactions, troubleshooting activities, and resolutions in the technical support database. Identify product non-conformities and support warranty, quality, and engineering investigations. Assist with product evaluations, testing, warranty validation, and technical issue resolution. Collaborate with Engineering, Quality, and Product Management teams to provide field feedback and support product improvements. Develop and maintain technical documentation, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge-base resources. Assist with customer training programs and onboarding support for new team members. Participate in after-hours support rotation as required. Support customers with repair recommendations, return authorizations, and parts identification. Maintain current knowledge of WEG products, applications, and emerging technologies. Deliver a high level of customer service while managing expectations and resolving technical concerns. Education Bachelor's degree in engineering preferred, or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience. High School Diploma or GED required. Experience & Knowledge 3 to 7 years of experience supporting industrial automation, drives, controls, electrical systems, or related technologies. Knowledge of Low Voltage Drives, Soft Starters, motors, and industrial electrical systems. Familiarity with Medium Voltage Drives, DC Drives, and System Drives. Experience with PLCs, HMIs, SCADA systems, and industrial communication networks such as Ethernet/IP, Modbus, Profibus, DeviceNet, or BACnet. Understanding of AC/DC motor control, power electronics, and industrial automation systems. Experience utilizing diagnostic software, test equipment, and remote support tools. Knowledge of applicable safety standards, including NFPA 70E, NEC, and OSHA requirements. Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and technical manuals. Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities. Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment. Professional customer service skills, including managing escalated customer situations. Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications Location: Duluth, GA Travel Limited travel required for customer support, technical training, system evaluations, or escalated troubleshooting activities. Schedule Monday through Friday We offer a pleasant work environment, competitive compensation and full benefits package. To Apply: All candidates must submit an updated resume and complete our application in order to be considered for this position. Must be authorized to work in the United States. WEG does not offer visa sponsorship for this role. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, disability, veteran, or other protected status.

review_candidates.title: Senior Technical Support Analyst
review_candidates.description: Talent Centric Ltd. is seeking a Sr. Technical & User Support Analyst for an INGO to serve as the Level 3 technical support lead for its digital health platforms. This role is responsible for resolving complex technical issues escalated from partner-managed Level 1 and Level 2 support teams, while ensuring platform stability and performance. The role also plays a critical part in improving support processes, strengthening partner capacity, and ensuring smooth platform operations across deployments. Job Responsibilities: • Serve as the Level 3 escalation point for complex application and system issues unresolved by Level 1 and Level 2 support teams. • Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve advanced platform issues related to system functionality, data synchronization, integrations, and performance. • Replicate issues, perform root cause analysis, and document findings to support long-term product improvements. • Escalate unresolved issues to global product and engineering teams, providing detailed diagnostics, logs, and reproduction steps. • Track escalated issues through to resolution and ensure clear communication with partners and internal stakeholders. • Identify recurring issues and recommend improvements to prevent future incidents. • Guide partners on Level 1 and Level 2 support processes by strengthening SOPs, escalation protocols, and troubleshooting capabilities. • Maintain and improve technical support workflows, documentation, and escalation frameworks. • Support platform deployments, upgrades, and feature rollouts from a technical support perspective. • Facilitate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and validation of new releases to ensure stability and functionality. • Maintain technical documentation including troubleshooting guides, knowledge base articles, and structured documentation of known issues and workarounds. • Develop advanced troubleshooting materials for both partner and internal support teams. • Conduct periodic system and process audits at facilities and field sites to ensure correct and effective platform usage. • Monitor key technical KPIs (e.g., user adoption, error trends, ticket volumes, and resolution times) and share insights with stakeholders. Additional Requirements: • Growth mindset and willingness to go above and beyond formal role expectations. • Minimum 3 years of experience in technical support, product support, or similar roles. • Strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills. • Ability to communicate complex technical issues to non-technical stakeholders. • Strong written and verbal communication skills. • Experience supporting digital health platforms or health information systems. • Prior experience in field-level technical support, especially in low-resource or rural settings. • Familiarity with ticketing or issue-tracking systems. • Experience using data or analytics tools for reporting. • Knowledge of the software development lifecycle (SDLC). Education: • Bachelor’s degree in any discipline required. • A background in science, engineering, information technology, or related fields is preferred.
